research_question: Does a task-preselected query rule (selective on PullCube; mandatory read at t=4 on StackCube) preserve task success of the full mandatory strategy while spending fewer private memory reads on an entirely unseen 64-state cohort?

motivation_development_only.prior_physical_results: Pull selective 32/32 fixed 32/32; Stack selective 13/32 fixed 23/32; this selection is retrospective to the DEVELOPMENT cohort and requires a new heldout test

intervention.controller: Panda pd_ee_delta_pose source to pd_ee_target_delta_pose destination
intervention.native_fault: two consecutive arm target holds / zero arm deltas, at steps t=2,t=3; gripper unchanged
intervention.ack: unknown, not real lost network packets

precommitted_router.selection_time: before environment reset, based ONLY on known task ID; no test-outcome access
precommitted_router.cost: exact decision-time privileged get_state calls; oracle continuous privileged access not zero
precommitted_router.implementation: task-gated selected trajectory is the actual native PhysX rollout of its selected comparator, which is run among seven paired worlds on every original seed (not a synthesized hybrid trajectory)

primary_endpoints: 64 paired official native task success flags and separate PullCube/StackCube results
query counts of task-gated vs always-read and always-selective
paired discordant wins / losses, exact two-sided exploratory McNemar test
all original SHA256 and emitted physical setpoint audits, including masked commands
four candidate target-memory states actually reached
methodological_limits: Route only has two known tasks; this is explicit per-task specialization not learned policy and not evidence of task-general information planning
Source task policy models are only 2 PPOs in one Panda controller family; 64 reset seeds are not 64 independent robots

Reusing original comparator outcomes is valid only because the route fixes choice before reset and selects an *entire actually executed* control trajectory; we make no claims for counterfactual mid-episode splices
No clinical/hardware/robot trajectory safety or true network ACK loss
Outside-run independent replication must come from an actual third-party investigator
decision_rule: If the new task-conditioned policy is worse than full mandatory readback on PullCube or pooled task success, report failure; no retuning on these 64 seeds. If task success ties, compare actual reads; no statistical noninferiority claim unless a priori equivalence margin with adequate power exists.
